binders.name: N,d; Fin N, Fin d
binders.meaning: N>0 is the finite normalization convention. d supplies the exact Euclidean coordinate dimension; no d>=3 assumption is needed for the identity.

binders.name: Ω; MeasurableSpace Ω; P : ProbabilityMeasure Ω
binders.meaning: One actual probability space; its measure is used in all Brownian contracts, integrals and expectations.

binders.name: filtration : Filtration NNReal m
binders.meaning: A monotone family of sub-sigma algebras of the same ambient measurable space m. No second hidden probability space.

binders.name: B; hB
binders.meaning: For each i one actual d-dimensional standard Brownian process relative to the specified common filtration. The same coordinate of B i drives X i and Y i. No separate scalar-driver or particle-independence certificate.

binders.name: hUsual
binders.meaning: Completeness at every time and right continuity of the common filtration.

binders.name: X,Y; hX,hY
binders.meaning: Actual sphere-valued processes, jointly measurable using time Borel and original sample measurable structure.

binders.name: hProgressiveX,hProgressiveY
binders.meaning: Strong progressive measurability relative to the common filtration, the standard adapted stochastic-solution input.

binders.name: bX,bY; hbX,hbY
binders.meaning: Non-radial fields continuous jointly in time and both finite configurations for each particle; random coefficient processes are these fields evaluated at X,Y. No externally supplied coefficient bound.

binders.name: lambda; hlambda
binders.meaning: One deterministic constant nonnegative temperature, including zero.

binders.name: hEquation
binders.meaning: Exactly the supplied coordinate stochastic integral equation; all horizons precede the almost-everywhere event, all times/finite coordinates lie inside it. This contains no nonlinear test identity, differentiated expectation, supplied covariance, or ready-made martingale conclusion.

binders.name: delta,D,R4,L,G
binders.meaning: Literal local definitions in the conclusion; no witnesses/abstract observables may substitute for the actual expectations. R4 uses the fourth moment, not the square of the second.

binders.name: Continuous G; local integrability; integral balance; AC; derivatives
binders.meaning: All regularity and stochastic-observable results are to be proved from prior data, not supplied. Zero uses a right derivative only.

definition_closure.name: EuclideanSpace R (Fin d)
definition_closure.meaning: The genuine WithLp 2 real Euclidean space, with its standard inner product, Borel measurable space, and finite-dimensional complete topology; not the ordinary Pi sup norm.

definition_closure.name: S=Metric.sphere 0 1; C=Fin N -> S
definition_closure.meaning: Literal norm-one subtype and finite configuration product, with induced subtype/product topology and Borel measurable structures. The source sphere is not an abstract placeholder.

definition_closure.name: SatisfiesUsualConditions
definition_closure.meaning: completeAt: every ambient measure-null set is measurable in every filtration t; rightContinuous: filtration.IsRightContinuous.

definition_closure.name: IsStandardBrownianMotionWithFiltration
definition_closure.meaning: isStandard, stronglyAdapted, and for s<=t independence of filtration s from the comap of the future vector increment B t-B s.

definition_closure.name: IsStandardBrownianMotion
definition_closure.meaning: B0 is zero pointwise; disjoint half-open interval increments are independent as a finite family; every continuous real linear projection of an increment has Gaussian mean zero and variance (t-s)||ell||^2; paths are continuous almost surely.

definition_closure.name: IsStronglyProgressive
definition_closure.meaning: For every time a, the restriction on Iic a x Omega is strongly measurable for the product of time-subtype measurable space and filtration a. This implies strong adaptedness, including initial-coordinate measurability.

definition_closure.name: coordinateFamily hB
definition_closure.meaning: Its process j t omega is exactly (B t omega).ofLp j. Its scalar Brownian-filtration proof is derived from the single vector Brownian contract; it does not add a driver.

definition_closure.name: IsBrownianMotionWithFiltration
definition_closure.meaning: Scalar Mathlib Brownian property plus strong adaptedness and future increment independence from the whole common past. For each pair these are projections of the same B_i.

definition_closure.name: projectedNoiseColumn j x
definition_closure.meaning: EuclideanSpace.single j 1 - (x j) smul x, whose kth coordinate is 1_{k=j}-x_j x_k.

definition_closure.name: sphereMeasurableNoiseIntegrand T X hX hProgressive (fun _ => lambda) ... k j
definition_closure.meaning: The actual representative is (t,omega) -> sqrt(2lambda)*(projectedNoiseColumn j (X t omega)) k. The existing implementation derives progressivity and L2 membership from the explicit sphere constraint, constant coefficient and compactness. The displayed measurability and bound proof arguments are measurable_const and ||lambda||<=||lambda||; they are not new mathematical hypotheses.

definition_closure.name: ProgressiveL2Integrand
definition_closure.meaning: A scalar process, its strong progressivity, and MemLp exponent 2 on probability x finite time. This structure occurs as an internally constructed value in hEquation, not an arbitrary supplied eta witness.

definition_closure.name: processFunction eta
definition_closure.meaning: (omega,t) -> eta t omega, preserving the probability-first orientation.

definition_closure.name: TimeMeasure.upTo T
definition_closure.meaning: Measure.comap of NNReal-to-Real applied to real Lebesgue measure restricted to [0,T]. It is finite and equal to nonnegative Lebesgue time restricted to [0,T].

definition_closure.name: prefixIntegralProcess b t omega
definition_closure.meaning: The Bochner integral of b s omega with respect to TimeMeasure.upTo t. Drift integrability is to be derived from the compact continuous coefficient fields.

definition_closure.name: itoIntegralProcess eta hT hB hUsual
definition_closure.meaning: At each sample, the canonical uniform path limit of elementary integrals, patched by zero on the completed null bad set. The existing producer supplies its continuous path, martingale and L2/integrability properties. hB determines the literal scalar driver. This is reused, not postulated as an arbitrary stochastic integral.

definition_closure.name: Real.toNNReal
definition_closure.meaning: max(t,0), transported to NNReal. It makes the real-time extension constant at negative times; no assertion of two-sided differentiability at zero follows.

definition_closure.name: Bochner expectation and finite sums
definition_closure.meaning: All expectations are real Bochner integrals against P. Unit-sphere chord bounds and finite-horizon compact coefficient bounds must supply integrability; totalized integral values alone do not certify this.

definition_closure.name: AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval and derivative predicates
definition_closure.meaning: Standard Mathlib real interval AC, HasDerivAt for t>0 and HasDerivWithinAt on Ici 0 at zero.
